title: quercus ilex var. gramuntia
intro:
Quercus ilex var. gramuntia, commonly known as holm oak or Pyrenean oak, is a variety of evergreen tree native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus ilex var. gramuntia include wound healing, pain relief, and antiviral activity, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyphenols, flavonoids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
